bibl.title: The Second Life of the El Hibeh Literary Papyri: A Case Study.
bibl.seg: Francesca Maltomini, The Second Life of the El Hibeh Literary Papyri: A Case Study.
bibl.note: An earlier version of the paper was presented during the 28th International Congress of Papyrology (Barcelona, August 1-6, 2016). - A considerable number of El Hibeh papyri bear writing on the verso as well, providing evidence of a second (documentary) life that needs to be further investigated. A case study shows how this reuse can yield information that helps reconstruct the path followed by this important group of texts.
